title.narrative: EU contribution to the Standards and Trade Development Facility - STDF

description.narrative: The three outputs of the action are the following: - based on the exchange of information among providers of Sanitary and Phyto-Sanitary capacity building, and on the affective dialogue among relevant stakeholders, the good practice to support SPS capacity building is identified and disseminated; - the needs assessment, feasibility studies and projects proposals related to SPS capacity building are produced; - SPS capacity building projects in specific areas are supported.

The final target was not established. The Logical Framework presented with the Action Document for the EU Contribution to the STDF refers to a Minimum of one publication annually. It could thus be assumed that the overall number of publications reaches at least 6 by the end of the implementation period of 78 months. Sexdesegregation is not applicable.

This is a cumulative latest data value. The results have been independently verified. Sexdisaggregation not applicable. While this indicator was introduced in the Logical Framework enclosed in the Action Document for the EU Contribution to the STDF it has been not a part of the Logical Framework supporting the STD Mid Term Strategy 20152019. The STDF does not specifically report on the progress in the achievement of this indicator in the annual reports. However based on the information available on the website of STDF at least 10 documents on different thematic topics were delivered in 2015 2017. title.narrative: Number of projects completed with satisfactory outputs (as per individual results framework)

description.narrative: Number of projects completed with satisfactory outputs (as per individual results framework)

comment.narrative: Based on the Conclusions of the MidTerm Review 2014 With regards to the success of the portfolio of PPGs and PGs the results are impressive and a testament to the effective operation of the STDF WG approval process as well as the quality of support provided by the STDF Secretariat. Projects were deemed highly relevant to the needs of the beneficiaries. The interventions were also generally effective in that they delivered most of the benefits as planned. About 70 percent of projects are very efficient in producing the planned deliverables on time and within budget. Sexdisaggregation is not applicable.

The Logical Framework presented with the Action Document for the EU Contribution to the STDF defines the target of At least 70 of specific outputs achieved for each individual project. Sexdisaggregation is not applicable.

This is a cumulative latest data value. Based on the data reported in the STDF Annual Reports 14 projects were completed in 2015 2017 4 in 2014 7 in 2016 and 3 in 2017. The Annual Reports provide analytical data suggesting that all completed projects achieved the majority of the planned outputs. However the data allowing to measure the progress towards achievement of the established indicator have been not provided in the Annual Reports and not recorded in the Logical Frameworks. The results have not been independently verified. Sexdisaggregation is not applicable.
